name: mikser-io-ocr
description: Schema-driven OCR + structured-data extraction for mikser-io. Walks the catalog at onProcess, matches entities to zod schemas by glob, calls Vercel AI SDK's generateObject with multi-modal input (text / PDF / image), writes the validated result onto entity.meta. Schemas can be passed by name (via mikser-io-schemas's lookup) or by direct import.
